006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDayTimeDurationItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITimeItem;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
023 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-adjust-time-to-timezone">fn:adjust-time-to-timezone</a>
024 * function.
025 */
026public final class FnAdjustTimeToTimezone {
027  private static final String NAME = "adjust-time-to-timezone";
028  @NonNull
029  static final IFunction ONE_ARG_SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
030      .name(NAME)
031      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
032      .deterministic()
033      .contextDependent()
034      .focusIndependent()
035      .argument(IArgument.builder()
036          .name("arg")
037          .type(ITimeItem.type())
038          .zeroOrOne()
039          .build())
040      .returnType(ITimeItem.type())
041      .returnZeroOrOne()
042      .functionHandler(FnAdjustTimeToTimezone::executeOneArg)
043      .build();
044  @NonNull
045  static final IFunction TWO_ARG_SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
046      .name(NAME)
047      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
048      .deterministic()
049      .contextIndependent()
050      .focusIndependent()
051      .argument(IArgument.builder()
052          .name("arg")
053          .type(ITimeItem.type())
054          .zeroOrOne()
055          .build())
056      .argument(IArgument.builder()
057          .name("timezone")
058          .type(IDayTimeDurationItem.type())
059          .zeroOrOne()
060          .build())
061      .returnType(ITimeItem.type())
062      .returnZeroOrOne()
063      .functionHandler(FnAdjustTimeToTimezone::executeTwoArg)
064      .build();
065
066  private FnAdjustTimeToTimezone() {
067    // disable construction
068  }
069
070  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
071  @NonNull
072  private static ISequence<ITimeItem> executeOneArg(
073      @NonNull IFunction function,
074      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
075      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
076      IItem focus) {
077    ITimeItem arg = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
078    return arg == null
079        // Per spec, return empty sequence if the arg is null
080        ? ISequence.empty()
081        // use the implicit timezone
082        : ISequence.of(arg.replaceTimezone(dynamicContext.getImplicitTimeZoneAsDayTimeDuration()));
083  }
084
085  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
086  @NonNull
087  private static ISequence<ITimeItem> executeTwoArg(
088      @NonNull IFunction function,
089      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
090      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
091      IItem focus) {
092    ITimeItem arg = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
093    IDayTimeDurationItem timezone = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true));
094    return arg == null
095        // Per spec, return empty sequence if the arg is null
096        ? ISequence.empty()
097        // use the provided timezone
098        : ISequence.of(arg.replaceTimezone(timezone));
099  }
100}
